Named: © 2026 – café crème brûlée, «guillemets», 5 €, ½ × 4 ÷ 2 ± 1°.

Arrows ← → ↑ ↓ ↔, maths − ≤ ≥ ≠ ′ ″, marks † ‡ § ¶ • · … ‰.

Quotes: ‘single’ “double” ‚low’ „low“ ‹angle› it's "so".

Numeric: © © ☺ 😀 – (a windows-1252 dash) � (a replacement character).

Without semicolons: © 2026, fish & chips, x < y > z.

Unknown names stay: &bogus; &notanentity; AT&T &c.

Soft hyphens vanish; spaces: a b c d.
